# SDK snapshot

The `actionlint-extension-api` directory contains the public SDK from actionlint commit
`70c824363f307a5097e73531d18d00189cca6fe8`, including its MIT license. The
[manifest](actionlint-extension-api.snapshot.json) records the original blobs and file hashes. The snapshot contains no
host implementation and does not require a sibling checkout. Update the SDK as a whole, including generated protocol
files.
